derivationRule: Each answer contributes me exactly one character to the final access code. Combine Q1 + Q2 + Q3 + Q4 + Q5 + Q6 + Q7 + Q8 + Q9 + Q10 in order.

questions.title: Question 1: The Rogue MAC Address
questions.text: Inspect `system_logs.txt` between 02:10:00 and 02:18:00. Identify the source MAC address that triggered more than 40 dropped packet alerts on port 8080. Locate the final character of this MAC address (ignoring colons).
questions.derivation: The last hexadecimal character of the identified MAC address becomes character #1 of the code.

questions.title: Question 2: The Compromised Terminal
questions.text: Filter `devices.csv` using the MAC address identified in Q1 to discover the host's assigned IP address and terminal name. Take the 3rd character of the terminal's hostname.
questions.derivation: The 3rd character of the hostname becomes character #2 of the code.

questions.title: Question 3: Physical Badge Discrepancy
questions.text: Using the terminal's physical room location from Q2, examine `access_logs.csv` for any door unlock events between 01:50:00 and 02:20:00. Find the Badge ID used during the anomalous unlock. What is the first letter of the Badge ID?
questions.derivation: The first letter of the anomalous Badge ID becomes character #3 of the code.

questions.title: Question 4: The Staged Payload
questions.text: Search `login_logs.csv` for the username tied to the Badge ID from Q3. Determine the destination directory where their terminal staged the exfiltration script. Identify the 4th character of the script name.
questions.derivation: The 4th character of the staged script name becomes character #4 of the code.

questions.title: Question 5: Network Checksum Signature
questions.text: Isolate the outgoing stream in `network_traffic.csv` matching the script transfer identified in Q4. Calculate the modulo-10 check digit of the byte packet payload count (or check the final character of the SHA256 record).
questions.derivation: The resulting single character becomes character #5 of the code.

questions.title: Question 6: Firewall Alert Timestamp Offset
questions.text: Locate the emergency firewall shutdown alert in `system_logs.txt` recorded right after the payload transfer. What is the last digit of the minute timestamp?
questions.derivation: The last digit of the minute timestamp becomes character #6 of the code.

questions.title: Question 7: Port Redirection Vector
questions.text: Find the destination port used during the unauthorized payload transfer in `network_traffic.csv`. What is the first digit of this port number?
questions.derivation: The first digit of the destination port becomes character #7 of the code.

questions.title: Question 8: User Privilege Escalation
questions.text: In `login_logs.csv`, identify the elevated session privileges used during the script deployment. Find the first character of the elevated role name.
questions.derivation: The first character of the role name becomes character #8 of the code.

questions.title: Question 9: Subnet Tag Identifier
questions.text: Locate the VLAN subnet tag assigned to the compromised terminal in `devices.csv`. What is the last character of the VLAN identifier?
questions.derivation: The last character of the VLAN ID becomes character #9 of the code.

questions.title: Question 10: Final Sensor Verification Code
questions.text: Examine the terminal room sensor checkpoint status in `access_logs.csv` after the lockdown. What is the trailing verification symbol on the sensor log line?
questions.derivation: The trailing verification symbol becomes character #10 of the code.
